transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Business Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hello, Alex. I'm calling about a billing issue on our most recent invoice. My name is Thomas Anderson.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help with that, Thomas. To pull up your account, could I please get your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, the customer ID is CUST-2009.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. CUST-2009. And for security purposes, could you please verify the 6-digit account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The PIN is 3-5-8-8-7-2.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you for verifying. I see the account for Pinnacle Real Estate. Now, you mentioned a billing issue. Could you please explain what you're seeing?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes. We upgraded our service mid-cycle to your Gigabit plan. The new invoice correctly shows the higher pro-rated charge, but our internet speeds haven't actually changed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand the concern. You're paying for a higher speed tier but not receiving the service. I'm very sorry for that discrepancy. Let me pull up your service details and the latest invoice right now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I'm looking at the invoice generated five days ago. It does show a pro-rated charge for the 'Business Fiber Gigabit' plan. And you're saying the speeds are still at your previous tier?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's correct. We've run several speed tests and we're still capped around 500 megabits per second, which was our old plan.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming that. It sounds like there may have been an issue with the service provisioning. The billing system seems to have updated, but the network command may not have completed. I do apologize for that.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's what I suspected. So, how do we fix this?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The first step is for me to check the network provisioning system on my side. Would you mind if I place you on a brief hold for about one to two minutes while I investigate that?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Not at all, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'll be right back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Thomas. I've confirmed what happened. You were correct.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, and what is that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There was a system synchronization error. The billing change was approved and processed, but the corresponding order to update the speed profile on our network equipment failed to execute. I am truly sorry for this oversight on our part.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright. So what's the solution for the speed, and what about the money we've already paid for the faster service we didn't get?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm addressing both of those for you right now. First, I am manually forcing the provisioning command to your circuit. This will correct the speed issue. Second, I will be calculating and applying a credit to your account for the period you were overbilled.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds like the right path. How much will the credit be?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me calculate that precisely. Your previous 'Business Fiber 500' plan was $149 per month, and the new Gigabit plan is $199. The difference is $50 per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The upgrade was effective on the 15th of last month, so you were billed for 16 days at the higher rate without receiving the service. The pro-rated credit for those 16 days comes out to... one moment... twenty-six dollars and thirty cents.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Twenty-six thirty. Okay, that's acceptable. Will that be applied to our next bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. I am applying it to your account right now. You will see a line item for 'Service Adjustment Credit' in the amount of $26.30 on your next invoice. The credit has been applied successfully.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. Thank you. Now, about the speed?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The command I sent should have completed by now. To get the new speed profile, your primary router or Optical Network Terminal will need to be rebooted. Are you near the equipment?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I'm in our server closet now. I can reboot it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Please unplug the power cord from the main Cymbal Telecom device, wait 30 seconds, and then plug it back in. The device will then take a few minutes to restart and sync with our network.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, unplugging now... and waiting.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, 30 seconds are up. I'm plugging it back in now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. You should see the lights begin to flash. It can take anywhere from three to five minutes for it to fully come back online and for the internet light to turn solid.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yep, I see the power and status lights blinking. We can wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While we wait, I've added detailed notes to your account regarding this issue, including the credit reference number, so this is all documented. I've also flagged the account for a follow-up check to ensure the sync issue doesn't happen on future orders.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's very thorough. I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure. We want to ensure this is a one-time issue.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, it looks like the lights are stabilizing. The internet light is now a solid blue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent news. That indicates it's connected to our network with the new profile. Do you have a computer nearby connected via an Ethernet cable to run a definitive speed test?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I have my laptop right here. Let me run one... Okay, the test is running...

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow, okay. Yes. It's showing 938 megabits per second download and 910 upload. That's what we were looking for.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic. I'm so glad to hear that. Those speeds are right in line with the Gigabit service. It looks like everything is now working as it should be.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Finally. Thank you for your help in sorting this out, Alex.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome, Thomas. It was my pleasure to get this resolved for you. Again, I apologize for the initial error and the inconvenience it caused your business.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It's fixed now, that's what matters.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I agree. So, to quickly recap: we have successfully updated your internet to the correct Gigabit speed, and we've applied a credit of $26.30 to your account for the billing error. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was the only thing. We're all set now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, thank you for being a valued Cymbal Telecom business customer. We appreciate your patience today. Have a great afternoon.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
